Admin full permissions across all modules: Close Job, Generate Report, Retry, View, Download PDF & ZIP
PE-MFG Leader Close Job, Final Report generation, View, Download PDF & ZIP
File System Access API streaming 'Save As' with prompt user folder selection and graceful cancel
Cross-browser fallback for browsers lacking File System Access API with user settings instructions
Planning Job creation & routing definition (OP10, OP20, etc.) with automatic YYYYMM-### numbering
PE-MFG production recording (OK, NG details, KIV tracking) and compact desktop layout
Operation sample photos gallery and NG defect photos
Engineering Documents management (Drawings, Checksheets, Settings, Charts)
QA Inspection check per operation with pass/fail/conditional controls
Gate B fail-closed RLS security and unforgeable immutable audit logging
Production database & private Storage backup utility with SHA-256 manifest verification
